description: Search the Tileio library by free text and filters. Returns layer ids with their catalogue number (the N° shown on tileio.com), title, category, subtitle (industry, section type, technique...), tier, tone, description and page URL. get_prompt on a premium layer counts toward a daily limit; pass tier "free" to list only layers with no limit.

query.description: Words to match, e.g. "pricing table", "dark saas hero", "particles". All words must match.

name: search_layers
title: Search Tileio layers
